A bullet of mass 0.10kg travels horizontally at a speed of 600m/s. It strikes a stationary wooden
block of mass 1.90kg resting on a frictionless, horizontal surface.
The bullet stays in the block.
What is the speed of the bullet and the block immediately after the impact?
A
30m/s
B
32m/s
C
60m/s
D
134m/s
subject: Physics
